sloka: उरसा पातयामास जीमूतमिव मारुतः ।स तथा पातितस्तेन कपिना पर्वतोत्तमः ॥५-१-१०९॥
transliteration: urasā pātayāmāsa jīmūtamiva mārutaḥ ।sa tathā pātitastena kapinā parvatottamaḥ ॥5-1-109॥

translations.english: Felled by the vanara's speed, the tall mountain overwhelmed with joy roared in high pitch.
